title: Methane emissions remain flat even as biggest US oil region opens the tap
title_zh: 甲烷排放持平，即使美国最大产油区开闸生产
abstract: Output of the greenhouse gas from the Permian Basin has remained near constant over a period during which oil and gas production tripled.
abstract_zh: 在石油和天然气产量翻三倍的这段期间，得墨西哥产盆地的温室气体排放量一直保持近乎不变。
